name: Johnny's Pizza & Pasta
description: Johnny's Pizza & Pasta Ristorante Italiano in Spring Mount. BYO. Pizza, stromboli, grinders, plus pasta, seafood, steak, and veal. Delivers a 3 mile radius.

hero.headline: It's all about the food and service
hero.sub: Johnny's Pizza & Pasta sits at 5 Main Street in Spring Mount. BYO. Pizza, stromboli, and grinders, plus pasta, seafood, steak, and veal. Call 610.287.4771. Delivery inside a 3 mile radius.

offerings.heading: Pizza on the sign. <mark>Ristorante on the plate.</mark>
items: Pizza, stromboli, and grinders for the nights you want the regular order.
Pasta, seafood, steak, and veal when the table is here for a sit-down, not a slice.
BYO, plus delivery inside a 3 mile radius of Spring Mount.

story.heading: A ristorante that still sells a lot of pizza
paragraphs: Johnny's will tell you they sell a lot of pizza, stromboli, and grinders. They'll also tell you they're a ristorante. Pasta, seafood, steak, and veal are on the same menu.
The address is 5 Main Street, Spring Mount. Bring the bottle. Call 610.287.4771 if you want it delivered inside three miles.

experience.heading: How a night at Johnny's goes.
items: Walk in on Main Street, or call the order in for takeout.
BYO means the wine is yours. The kitchen still runs the plate.
Delivery stays inside a 3 mile radius of Spring Mount. Past that, you drive.

feature.heading: The regular stromboli, then the rest of the menu
feature.text: People come for pizza. They stay because the kitchen will still do seafood, steak, and veal if you ask for a real dinner.

catalog.heading: Order in, take out, <mark>or sit down.</mark>

contact.heading: Main Street, <mark>Spring Mount.</mark>
contact.sub: 5 Main Street. Confirm hours on the official site before you drive.
